Hymn 267: How Wondrous and Great
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major

This is hymn number 267 titled "How Wondrous and Great" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Johann Michael Haydn and the lyrics were written by Henry U. Onderdonk.
